answer: Let each identity earn weight only by climbing a ladder: three rounds of verified work, locking 20 POA for 14 days, then 50 POA for 28 days, then 120 POA for 56 days. Progress is slow like a glacier and the cost gap widens like a canyon, because a sybil operator must fund and staff every fake identity through all rounds, with earlier bonds still locked when later fakes start. Each extra fake ties up more capital at once, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps its standing. Auditors mark each passed round in saffron and slash the ladder bond on fraud, making bulk fakery costlier.
